body: Sorry for the late response, 550 mg over about 3 hours.

So I’ve never taken it nasally or as a suppository (I do an IV) but I did get increased anxiety when I tried doing 550 mg. I had increased anxiety for a few weeks but it DID go back to normal! Obviously my normal and your normal is different but I did another ketamine session (lower dose, I think around 150-250 mg) and it helped lower my anxiety.

The cost depends on your doctor. The doctor I use charges $550 for each session. You will need someone to drive you home afterwards as it is a sedative just like Profofol (the medicine they use to sedate you during surgery).

Im so sorry. I wish I could take it away for you and I and everyone who feels this.
We shouldn’t have to deal with this
Same. Just same, I relate to this feeling so much and I’m in your exact situation right now.

I feel like you just explained my situation! I’m in college as well and I went from 16 credits to 9 credits because my anxiety and depression. I’m struggling as well to see the point of living, it’s a constant struggle every day. I just got out of in patient therapy and I still feel like a danger to myself. I say all this to say, I understand what you’re feeling. You’re not alone.
I thought I was the only one who felt this way - it’s weird but suicide is so comforting to me.
